title: Unicode edge cases docx 002
notes: real codepoint edge content: mathematical double-struck (sans) letters U+1D54F/U+1D550 outside the BMP; mathematical bold digit numerals U+1D7CF/U+1D7D0/U+1D7D1 (non-ASCII digit forms that break naive isdigit/number extraction); U+2764 heart paired with VS15 U+FE0E (text) vs VS16 U+FE0F (emoji) — same base codepoint, different presentation; a bidi sandwich of LRM U+200E + RLM U+200F-wrapped Hebrew inside an LTR paragraph; and U+FEFF zero-width no-break space as the FIRST character of a paragraph. Reference text is the byte-exact inserted codepoints. LibreOffice font coverage varies per glyph class: missing glyphs rendering as tofu .notdef boxes is a REAL fidelity finding, not a generator bug.
